_note: 2026-11-13 (plan L0-CLOSE step 8): the pass has its own reference error, pass_error_ref_rad (a pass is aimed at a man who comes to meet it), today equal to the shot's. The kick (ADR-051, the family 'the kick'), first for the shot. No die (ADR-035). Speed: speed_ref x (base + (1 - base) x power) x (explosive_base + (1 - explosive_base) x explosive_force), cm/tick (10 ticks = 1 s): a placed shot by an average player leaves at about 17 m/s, a strong one at about 23 m/s, the strongest at about 28 m/s. Precision is an angle: error = error_ref x (1 - skill) x (0.5 + power_gain x power) + error_pressure x pressure, in radians, with skill = shooting x (0.5 + 0.5 x the quality of the foot he kicks with); the miss is the distance times the angle, so the same player misses by more from farther away, and a strong shot is less precise than a placed one. vertical_share is the share of the error that goes up (a miscued strike rises). aim_low_cm and aim_high_cm are the heights the shooter aims at for a low and a high shot (his contact_height choice). The pass is weighed (2026-11-13): the passer gives it the speed that brings it to the receiver still rolling at pass_arrive_cm_per_tick (6 m/s), knowing the ground friction (ball.json): v0 = arrive + distance x (1 - friction), capped by his strongest kick; the error angle (from passing and the foot) makes it drift across the line by distance x angle and overhit by the same share. A clearance (2026-11-13): his strongest kick, towards a point clear_length_cm up the pitch on the wing of his side, lifted (the vertical speed is clear_loft of the horizontal one). A lofted pass (2026-11-13) flies loft_ticks_per_10m ticks for every ten metres (0.6 s: a 30 m ball is in the air about 1.8 s) and is lifted to stay up that long; its error widens the distance as for a ground pass. The keeper's throw (2026-11-13, plan L0-CLOSE 10d): from his hands, to a teammate within throw_max_cm, at most throw_speed_cm_per_tick, its precision his hands' (goalkeeping) with both hands; farther he kicks it. On the run (2026-11-13, plan L0-CLOSE 11): a shot struck running adds run_error_rad x (his speed / run_speed_ref, at most 1) x (1 - body_control) to the error: the contact is less clean the faster he runs, the less so the better his balance. Across his body: the same term grows by the sine of the angle between his run and the shot (twice at right angles). Fatigue dims the shooter's technique (finishing and the foot) by the share it dims his acceleration (movement.json fatigue_coefficient, ADR-030; VISION §3, the dimmer). The shooter's own reckoning does not include them yet. The contact (2026-11-13, plan L0-CLOSE 11, SIM_VERSION 91): the error is a spread, not an offset. Its width is the angle above; where in it the ball goes is the contact, from the phase of his stride when his foot meets the ball (each player's stride moves on with the ground he covers, a step being the fastest top speed over the cadence, movement.json): met in the middle of the step the strike is clean, late the foot opens and the ball runs away from the post he chose and rises, early it is pulled back across and kept low. He cannot see it as he decides: he knows how wide, as well as he reads it, not which way.
_source: Order of magnitude from observation of real matches: shot speeds of about 15-30 m/s; about one shot in three on target. Arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3 against real shot speed, placement and on-target distributions. throw_speed (18 m/s) and throw_max (35 m): order of magnitude of a keeper's overarm throw, declared, to be sourced at L3. run_error_rad (about 9 degrees at a full run for a player with no balance) and run_speed_ref (8 m/s): arbitrary, declared, set once and not tuned, to be sourced at L3 (shooting accuracy while running). error_ref_rad (2026-11-13, SIM_VERSION 91): derived from Shimotashiro and Shinya 2024 (Frontiers in Sports and Active Living, 10.3389/fspor.2024.1434096): sixteen players with about ten years of football, recreational level, instep kicks from 11 m with the preferred foot at about 95% of their top ball speed, 95% confidence ellipse 6.17 m2, so a spread of about 0.57 m per axis (6.17 / (pi x 5.99)), 0.052 rad. Taken as the bottom of the professional range (skill 0) at power 0.95: the contact spreads the miss evenly across the width, whose standard deviation is the width over the square root of 3, so width = 0.052 x 1.73 = 0.090 rad = error_ref x (0.5 + 0.95), error_ref = 0.062. Before, 0.08, arbitrary. pass_error_ref_rad stays declared at 0.08 (the source is for the instep shot). vertical_share (2026-11-13, SIM_VERSION 91): derived from the same source, whose ellipse spreads about as much up and down as across (its area is read as one spread per axis). Across, the contact spreads the ball evenly over twice the width (standard deviation width / sqrt 3); up, from the height he aimed at to vertical_share x width (standard deviation vertical_share x width / sqrt 12); equal when vertical_share = 2. Before, 0.5, arbitrary.
